<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="360" height="800" viewBox="0 0 360 800">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="0" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.22"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="360" height="800" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="360" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="18" y="20" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="293" y1="17" x2="297" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="14" x2="304" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="307" y1="11" x2="311" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="322" cy="16" r="3" fill="#000000"/>
  <line x1="327" y1="13" x2="331" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="17" x2="335" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="341" y="10" width="16" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="357" y="13" width="2" height="5" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Loading content -->
  <text x="180" y="174" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">We are translating it</text>
  <text x="180" y="211" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">please wait...</text>

  <!-- Loading illustration frame -->
  <rect x="62" y="267" width="236" height="174" rx="36" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- Geometric loading illustration -->
  <rect x="108" y="307" width="144" height="78" rx="8" fill="#D9D9D9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="143" cy="335" r="12" fill="#000000"/>
  <polygon points="120,370 154,340 178,361 204,329 240,370" fill="#000000"/>
  <line x1="123" y1="399" x2="237" y2="399" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="165" cy="399" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="180" cy="399" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="399" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Progress indicator -->
  <rect x="78" y="486" width="204" height="14" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="80" y="488" width="116" height="10" rx="5" fill="#000000"/>
  <text x="180" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Translating monkey sounds</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="720" width="360" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="28,752 40,741 52,752 52,765 44,765 44,756 36,756 36,765 28,765" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="40" y="785" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="117" cy="751" r="13" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="113" y="745" width="8" height="13" rx="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <line x1="108" y1="754" x2="108" y2="760" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="126" y1="754" x2="126" y2="760" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="117" y="785" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Record</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="175" y="739" width="40" height="28" rx="8" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="187" cy="753" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="196" y1="747" x2="207" y2="747" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="196" y1="753" x2="207" y2="753" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="196" y1="759" x2="204" y2="759" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="195" y="785" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Translate</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="286" y="742" width="28" height="22" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="314,748 322,744 322,760 314,756" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="295,748 295,758 306,753" fill="#000000"/>
    <text x="304" y="785" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Replay</text>
  </g>
</svg>
